What makes cursive text cursive

Most people arrive here wanting one line of a bio to look handwritten, and this is the alphabet that does it. Unicode calls it mathematical script and put it at U+1D49C, where it stands in for the flowing capitals mathematicians use for sets and transforms. Eleven of its letters are not in that run at all: ℬ ℰ ℱ ℋ ℐ ℒ ℳ ℛ ℯ ℊ and ℴ already existed in the older Letterlike Symbols block, and Unicode does not encode a character twice.

Those eleven are why a script name sometimes looks uneven, since a font may draw them from a different design than the rest of the set. Bold script is the fix if that bothers you, being one unbroken run. Otherwise this suits a display name, a caption or a wedding message, and suits nothing that anyone has to find later, because a search for your plain name will not match these letters.

Where Script / Cursive text works, and where it does not

WorksWorks in most bios, posts, display names and chat — X, Instagram, TikTok, Discord, Reddit. Watch outRefused by real-name fields (Facebook, LinkedIn's name field) and unsearchable: these are separate characters from ordinary letters, so nobody will find you by typing your name.

Script / Cursive questions

Does it work on Instagram?

Bios, captions and comments are ordinary text fields, so pasted script characters appear there the way they appear anywhere else, subject to the reader's device font. Two things do not carry over. A hashtag written in script is a different hashtag from the plain one, and name search will not match the styled spelling.

Why do some letters look heavier or narrower than the others?

Eleven of them come from a separate Unicode block that was designed years earlier. A font can draw those eleven with different proportions, a different stroke weight or a different slope than the main run, and the mismatch shows most in capitals. Bold script has no borrowed letters and stays even.

Is cursive text the same as a handwriting font?

No. A font is a file that redraws the letters you typed, and it only works where that file is installed. This swaps in characters that were designed to look cursive, so the appearance travels with the text into any field, at the cost of not being ordinary letters any more.
